items.reason: Gap 0 says 30 January renews on 2 March because February overflows into March.
Gap 1 says a charge awaiting strong customer authentication is treated as paid and renewsAt moves forward with nothing collected.
Gap 2 says the retry key is built from the unchanged renewsAt so the gateway replays the stored response without trying the card.
Gap 3 says a resumed subscription keeps its old renewsAt and is charged a month per night for the paused time.
No gap raises replicas or overlapping runs charging a customer twice.
No gap raises a crash between charge and save causing a double charge.
